{{recipe}}

'''Boiled fish''' is a major ingredient in the preparation of many Nigerian soups. It is also served with other foods, such as rice and beans, fried rice, jollof rice, and many others.

==Ingredients==
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Fish|fish]]
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
#Cut fresh fish into suitable sized pieces, and wash thoroughly. Remove unwanted substances inside the fish.
#Put fish in a pot, cover with water, and add a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt.
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] for a few minutes until cooked but tender.
